Velocity model v0.4.0: v0.3.1 re-inverted with the re-timed picks

v0.3.1 configuration re-inverted with the re-timed picks (D-B072/D-B075); no surface treatment, no D-B073 rule. Generated by workflow/10_tomography/b2_v040_analyse.py (branch tomo/v040-retimed). Same events, picks, weights, OBS S statics, P-4 rule, damping 200, smoothing and merge rules as v0.3.1; only the pick times differ (D-B072/D-B075). ridges_north was not rerun: it is out of the merge (D-B050).
